rdfs:label: followers
rdfs:comment: The Collection of actors who follow an ActivityPub actor (Person, Application, Group, Organization or Service) — used both for delivery (servers fan Activities out to followers) and for display.
notes: Defined by ActivityPub (§5.3), not the AS2 Vocabulary. The actor's audience — addressed as `as:to: <followers-uri>` in many activities to broadcast to the Collection without enumerating each follower. Servers may keep this Collection private (returning only `totalItems`) for privacy. Inverse direction is `as:following`.
